asucinā'ti jigucchanīyena.

28429.meaning1: detesting; being disgusted (by); being sick (of); being repulsed (by)

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, atidhāvanti eke? bhaven'eva kho pan'eke aṭṭīyamānā harāyamānā jigucchamānā vibhavaṃ abhinandanti
te iminā kāyena aṭṭīyamānā harāyamānā jigucchamānā satthahārakaṃ pariyesanti.

28430.meaning1: something abhorrent; self-torture; (comm) abhorrence of evil

examples.text: tapojigucchāya susaṃvut'atto, vācaṃ pahāya kalahaṃ janena, samosavajjā virato saccavādī, na hi nūna tādisaṃ karoti pāpan'ti.
tam'ūpanissāya jigucchitaṃ vā, athavā'pi diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, uddhaṃsarā suddhim'anutthunanti, avītataṇhāse bhav'ābhavesu.

28433.meaning1: should be disgusted; should be repulsed (by)
28433.commentary: (MNa) aṭṭīyitabban'ti aṭṭena pīḷitena bhavitabbaṃ. harāyitabban'ti lajjitabbaṃ. jigucchitabban'ti gūthaṃ disvā viya jigucchā uppādetabbā.

examples.text: evarūpaṃ pana te, rāhula, manokammaṃ aṭṭīyitabbaṃ harāyitabbaṃ jigucchitabbaṃ, aṭṭīyitvā harāyitvā jigucchitvā āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjitabbaṃ.
atthi, bhikkhave, puggalo jigucchitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo.

28434.meaningLit: discourse on should be disgusted by

28435.meaning1: having detested; having become disgusted (by); having got sick (of); having been repulsed (by)

examples.text: evarūpaṃ pana te, rāhula, manokammaṃ aṭṭīyitabbaṃ harāyitabbaṃ jigucchitabbaṃ, aṭṭīyitvā harāyitvā jigucchitvā āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjitabbaṃ.

bhuja ghasa hara su pā'icc'evam'ādīhi dhātūhi tum'icch'atthesu kha cha sa'icc'ete paccayā honti vā. bhottum'icchati, bubhukkhati, ghasitum'icchati, jighacchati, haritum'icchati, jigīsati, sotum'icchati, sussusati, pātum'icchati, pivāsati.

āturass'eva bhesajjaṃ, bhojanaṃ'va jighacchato, parinibbāpaya maṃ bhadde, jalantam'iva vārinā.

28439.commentary: (DHPa) jighacchāparamā rogā'ti yasmā añño rogo sakiṃ tikicchito vinassati vā tadaṅgavasena vā pahīyati, jighacchā pana niccakālaṃ tikicchitabbā'y'evā'ti sesarogānaṃ ayaṃ paramā nāma.

examples.text: jighacchāparamā rogā, saṅkhāraparamā dukhā, etaṃ ñatvā yathābhūtaṃ, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ.
khamā bhavissāma sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-sarīsapa-samphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ
kiñ'c'āpi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā jighacchādubbalyaṃ paṭivinodetvā evaṃ taṃ rattin'divaṃ vītināmeyya, atha kho asu'y'eva me purimo bhikkhu pujjataro ca pāsaṃsataro ca
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, api nu kho so kukkuro amuṃ aṭṭhikaṅkalaṃ sunikkantaṃ nikkantaṃ nimmaṃsaṃ lohitamakkhitaṃ palehanto jighacchādubbalyaṃ paṭivineyyā'ti?

28441.meaning1: afflicted with hunger and weakness; overcome by hunger and lack of strength
28441.commentary: (MNa) jighacchādubbalyaparetā'ti jighacchāya ca dubbalyena ca paretā phuṭṭhā anugatā ca aṭṭha'pi dasa'pi divasāni. tattha keci jighacchitā'pi na dubbalā honti, sakkonti jighacchaṃ sahituṃ. ime pana na tādisā'ti dassetuṃ ubhayam'āha

examples.text: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, seyyathā'pi, bhante, puriso jighacchādubbalyapareto madhupiṇḍikaṃ adhigaccheyya, so yato yato sāyeyya, labheth'eva sādurasaṃ asecanakaṃ
seyyathā'pi, gahapati, kukkuro jighacchādubbalyapareto goghātakasūnaṃ paccupaṭṭhito assa.
kiñ'c'āpi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā jighacchādubballaṃ paṭivinodetvā evaṃ taṃ rattin'divaṃ vītināmeyya, atha kho asu'y'eva me purimo bhikkhu pujjataro ca pāsaṃsataro ca
hatthesu, bhikkhave, sati ādānanikkhepanaṃ paññāyati. pādesu sati abhikkamapaṭikkamo paññāyati. pabbesu sati samiñjanapasāraṇaṃ paññāyati. kucchismiṃ sati jighacchāpipāsā paññāyati.

tam'enaṃ uṭṭhahitvā apāpuritvā olokeyya. tassa sahadassanena amanāpatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, pāṭikulyatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, jegucchatā ca saṇṭhaheyya, jighacchitānam'pi na bhottu'kamyatā assa, pag'eva suhitānaṃ.
bāttiṃsalakkhaṇā buddhā, cattālīsadijā'pi ca, nettā gopakhumā tesaṃ, jiñjukā phalasannibhā.
apaṇḍarā lohit'antā, jiñjukaphalasannibhā, āyatā ca visālā ca, nettā tava sudassanā.
ettha dāni, māluṅkyaputta, kiṃ dahare bhikkhū vakkhāma yatra hi nāma tvaṃ, bhikkhu, jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto saṃkhittena ovādaṃ yācasī'ti.
jiṇṇo'ham'asmi abalo vītavaṇṇo, nettā na suddhā savanaṃ na phāsu, m'āhaṃ nassaṃ momuho antarā'va, ācikkha dhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, jātijarāya idha vippahānaṃ.
yo uppatitaṃ vineti kodhaṃ, visaṭaṃ sappavisaṃ'va osadhehi, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

yattha pana mahantaṃ paribhavaṃ paṭilabhati, tattha ciram'pi vasati. so nivatth'avatthe jiṇṇe pilotikakhaṇḍena tasmim'pi jiṇṇe kenaci dinnaṃ aggaṇhanto hirikopīna-paṭicchādana-matten'eva carati. evaṃ gacchante kāle ekaṃ nigamagāmaṃ agamāsi.
na tena thero so hoti, yen'assa palitaṃ siro, paripakko vayo tassa, moghajiṇṇo'ti vuccati.
jiṇṇo'ham'asmi abalo vītavaṇṇo, nettā na suddhā savanaṃ na phāsu, m'āhaṃ nassaṃ momuho antarā'va, ācikkha dhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, jātijarāya idha vippahānaṃ.
yo mātaraṃ vā pitaraṃ vā, jiṇṇakaṃ gatayobbanaṃ, pahu santo na bharati, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

28453.meaning1: time when old; time when worn out

28454.commentary: (DHPa) khīṇamacche'ti te evarūpā bālā udakassa abhāvā khīṇamacche pallale parikkhīṇapattā jiṇṇakoñcā viya avajhāyanti.

examples.text: acaritvā brahmacariyaṃ, aladdhā yobbane dhanaṃ, jiṇṇakoñcā'va jhāyanti, khīṇamacche'va pallale.
rājā kiṃ kāraṇā mama putto khippaṃ paṭinivattī'ti pucchi. jiṇṇapurisaṃ disvā, devā'ti.
kumbh'ūpamaṃ kāyam'imaṃ viditvā, nagar'ūpamaṃ cittam'idaṃ ṭhapetvā. yodhetha māraṃ paññ'āvudhena, jitañ'ca rakkhe anivesano siyā.
yo sahassaṃ sahassena, saṅgāme mānuse jine, ekañ'ca jeyya'm'attānaṃ, sa ve saṅgāmaj'uttamo, attā have jitaṃ seyyo, yā c'āyaṃ itarā pajā.
evaṃ vutte, bhagavā tuṇhī ahosi. atha kho asur'indakabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, jito'si, samaṇa, jito'si, samaṇā'ti.
jitāni indriyāni anena samaṇena so'yaṃ jit'indriyo, samaṇo.

28461.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: kāḷ'ūpakāḷā vijito jito ca, aṅgo ca paṅgo ca guttijito ca, passi jahi upadhidukkhamūlaṃ, aparājito mārabalaṃ ajesi.
atha kho te licchavī aṅguliṃ phoṭesuṃ, jit'amha vata bho ambakāya, jit'amha vata bho ambakāyā'ti.

28464.notes: Thai pronunciation of Pāli, insertsion of the letter -a- between two consonants

examples.text: visesena kilesakhandhamār'ādayo māre jitavā'ti vijitāvī, taṃ vijitāvinaṃ sambuddhaṃ.
kadā nu'haṃ sabbhi samāgamesu, diṭṭho bhave dhammagarūhi tādibhi, yāthāvadassīhi jit'indriyehi, padhāniyo taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
jitāni indriyāni anena samaṇena so'yaṃ jit'indriyo, samaṇo.

28468.meaning1: conqueror; victor; champion; epithet of the Buddha

examples.text: jinaṃ vandatha gotamaṃ, jinaṃ vandāma gotamaṃ vijjācaraṇasampannaṃ, buddhaṃ vandāma gotamaṃ.
aparimeyy'ito kappe, caturo āsuṃ vināyakā, taṇhaṅ'karo medhaṅ'karo, atho'pi saraṇaṅ'karo, dīpaṅ'karo ca sambuddho, ekakappamhi te jinā.

28469.meaning1: who has conquered; who has overcome

examples.text: tattha katamā cha gehasitā upekkhā? cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā uppajjati upekkhā bālassa mūḷhassa mandassa puthujjanassa anodhijinassa avipākajinassa anādīnavadassāvino assutavato puthujjanassa.

28470.commentary: (DNa) jino'ti aññena jito samāno yaṃ tena tassa veṭhanaṃ vā sāṭako vā aññaṃ vā pana hiraññasuvaṇṇādivittaṃ gahitaṃ, taṃ anusocati ahosi vata me, taṃ taṃ vata me n'atthī'ti tappaccayā socati. evaṃ so jino vittaṃ anusocati.

examples.text: cha kho'me, gahapatiputta, ādīnavā jūtappamādaṭṭhānānuyoge. jayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, jino vittam'anusocati, sandiṭṭhikā dhanajāni, sabhāgatassa vacanaṃ na rūhati, mitt'āmaccānaṃ paribhūto hoti, āvāhavivāhakānaṃ apatthito hoti, akkhadhutto ayaṃ purisapuggalo n'ālaṃ dārabharaṇāyā'ti.
tañ'ca pana na sabbesaṃ, jinaputtānaṃ y'eva ārabbha bhaṇitaṃ, abyāvaṭā tumhe, ānanda, hotha tathāgatassa sarīrapūjāyā'ti.

akammaṃ h'etaṃ, mahārāja, jinaputtānaṃ yadidaṃ pūjā, sammasanaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ, yoniso manasikāro, satipaṭṭhān'ānupassanā, ārammaṇasāraggāho, kilesayuddhaṃ, sadattham'anuyuñjanā, etaṃ jinaputtānaṃ karaṇīyaṃ, avasesānaṃ devamanussānaṃ pūjā karaṇīyā.

28476.meaning1: words spoken by the Buddha; official doctrine

28478.meaning1: Buddha's teaching; doctrine of the Buddha
28478.meaning2: the Buddha's teaching; the Buddha's religion
28478.commentary: (THa) vusitaṃ jinasāsanan'ti jinassa sammāsambuddhassa sāsanaṃ maggabrahmacariyaṃ vuṭṭhaṃ parivuṭṭhaṃ. (THIa) saritvā jinasāsanan'ti kāṇakacchap'opam'ādi-satthu-ovādaṃ (saṃ. ni. 5.1117, ma. ni. 3.252) anussaritvā.

examples.text: kusalānañ'ca dhammānaṃ, paññāya ca parikkhayā, sabb'ākāra-var'ūpetaṃ, lujjate jinasāsanaṃ.
aladdhā cetaso santiṃ, citte avasavattinī, tato saṃvegam'āpādiṃ, saritvā jinasāsanaṃ.
manasā dānaṃ mayā dinnaṃ, manasā pasādam'āvahiṃ, pūjitā sabbasambuddhā, paccekā jinasāvakā.

28480.meaning1: Buddha's word; teaching of the Buddha
28480.commentary: (PRS) tattha pañca māre jitavā'ti jino, buddho. jinassa vacanaṃ jinavacanaṃ, tassa jinavacanassa yuttaṃ jinavacanayuttaṃ, tepiṭakassa buddhavacanassa māgadhikāya sabhāvaniruttiyā yuttaṃ anurūpam'evā'ti idaṃ adhikār'atthaṃ veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: yaṃ, mahārāja, bhagavatā bhaṇitaṃ, uttiṭṭhe nappamajjeyya, udare saṃyato siyā'ti, taṃ sabhāvavacanaṃ asesavacanaṃ nissesavacanaṃ nippariyāyavacanaṃ bhūtavacanaṃ tacchavacanaṃ yāthāvavacanaṃ aviparītavacanaṃ isivacanaṃ munivacanaṃ bhagavantavacanaṃ arahantavacanaṃ paccekabuddhavacanaṃ jinavacanaṃ sabbaññuvacanaṃ tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa vacanaṃ.
idha ākhyāte aniddiṭṭhesu sādhanesu kvaci dhātu vibhatti paccayānaṃ dīgha viparīt'ādesa lop'āgama'icc'etāni kāriyāni jinavacana-anurūpāni kātabbāni.

28481.meaning1: stamp of the Buddha's word; seal of official doctrine

28482.meaning1: (gram) in conformity with the Buddha's word

examples.text: idha ākhyāte aniddiṭṭhesu sādhanesu kvaci dhātu vibhatti paccayānaṃ dīgha viparīt'ādesa lop'āgama'icc'etāni kāriyāni jinavacan'ānurūpāni kātabbāni.
dānañ'ca yuddhañ'ca samānam'āhu, app'āpi santā bahuke jinanti, appam'pi ce saddahāno dadāti, ten'eva so hoti sukhī paratthā'ti.
sabbadānaṃ dhammadānaṃ jināti, sabbarasaṃ dhammaraso jināti, sabbaratiṃ dhammarati jināti, taṇhakkhayo sabbadukkhaṃ jināti.
sabbadānaṃ dhammadānaṃ jināti, sabbarasaṃ dhammaraso jināti, sabbaratiṃ dhammarati jināti, taṇhakkhayo sabbadukkhaṃ jināti.
tasmiṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, saṅgāme devā jiniṃsu, asurā parājiniṃsu.

28486.meaning1: to conquer; to overcome; to defeat

28488.meaning1: could defeat; should conquer; could overcomes

examples.text: yo sahassaṃ sahassena, saṅgāme mānuse jine, ekañ'ca jeyya'm'attānaṃ, sa ve saṅgāmaj'uttamo, attā have jitaṃ seyyo, yā c'āyaṃ itarā pajā.
akkodhena jine kodhaṃ, asādhuṃ sādhunā jine, jine kadariyaṃ dānena, saccen'ālikavādinaṃ.
sace, mārisā, dev'āsurasaṅgāme samupabyūḷhe asurā jineyyuṃ devā parājineyyuṃ, yena naṃ sakkaṃ devānam'indaṃ kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā mama santike āneyyātha asurapuran'ti.
aho vat'āyaṃ samīti yānakāraputto imissā nemiyā imañ'ca vaṅkaṃ imañ'ca jimhaṃ imañ'ca dosaṃ taccheyya, ev'āyaṃ nemi apagatavaṅkā apagatajimhā apagatadosā suddhā assa sāre patiṭṭhitā'ti.
so saṃsappati kāyena, saṃsappati vācāya, saṃsappati manasā. tassa jimhaṃ kāyakammaṃ hoti, jimhaṃ vacīkammaṃ, jimhaṃ manokammaṃ, jimhā gati, jimh'upapatti.

28495.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of jimha

examples.text: gunnaṃ ce taramānānaṃ, jimhaṃ gacchati puṅgavo, sabbā tā jimhaṃ gacchanti, nette jimhaṃ gate sati.
yāni kho pan'assa honti sāṭheyyāni kūṭeyyāni jimheyyāni vaṅkeyyāni, tāni yathābhūtaṃ āvikattā hoti satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu.
ahañ'hi, bhante, pahomi hatthidammaṃ sāretuṃ, yāvatakena antarena campaṃ gat'āgataṃ karissati sabbāni tāni sāṭheyyāni kūṭeyyāni vaṅkeyyāni jimheyyāni pātukarissati.

so jiyā mutto saro viya, yūthā apakkanto madahatthī viya ca icchit'icchitaṃ sen'āsanaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ vanapabbhāraṃ paribhuñjanto eko'va tiṭṭhati, eko'va nisīdati. sabb'iriyāpathesu eko'va adutiyo.

28498.meaning2: is defeated, loses (something, accusative, in dicing or gambling)

28499.meaning2: grows old; decays, wears out; perishes
